origins.section: A Snapshot Is the Digest of the Inputs in One Canonical Form
A Run Manifest Records What Went In and What Came Out, and Leaves Out the Clock
The Solver's Version Is an Input Too: Pin It and Record It

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-digest: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-digest: "The tempting fix, str(the_set), writes the set in its iteration order, which depends on the process's hash salt (lesson 10.2.1): two processes, two digests for the same set." Output: "str(set) digested, hash seed 1 eb4de6ee9e9b" / "hash seed 2 feb1d3d8c170".
recorded.prompt:q-left-out: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-left-out: "The clock is kept apart. The wall time of a run ... differs on every run ..., so a manifest that held it could never match another." Output: "kept out of the manifest: ['wall_seconds']".
recorded.prompt:q-pin: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-pin: "The OR-Tools wheel carries its own HiGHS and SCIP libraries ... HiGHS 1.12.0 ... So the OR-Tools version pins both the HiGHS and the SCIP that MathOpt runs, and the highspy version pins something else."

recorded.prompt:q-digest:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-digest:a: "str() of a dict follows insertion order too (the third line), so code that builds the dict the same way writes the same text on every run."
recorded.prompt:q-digest:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-digest:b: 10.2.1: "sorted() and a SHA-256 digest from hashlib do not [change], because they depend only on the characters". sha256('P017') is b61214da6d3c under both seeds.
recorded.prompt:q-digest:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-digest:d: str does not sort the set; it "writes the set in its iteration order". The page's fix is to sort first: "Sort it first, and it digests the same everywhere" ("sorted(set) digested e8a8a638ccc7").
recorded.prompt:q-left-out:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-left-out:b: The manifest holds "solver: its name and every parameter passed". The Reference table lists solver.params as "seed, threads, limits, tolerances".
recorded.prompt:q-left-out:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-left-out:c: The manifest holds "versions: Python, OR-Tools ...". Output: "versions.ortools \"9.15.6755\"".
recorded.prompt:q-left-out:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-left-out:d: "The work done is in. Nodes and iterations ... repeat when a run truly repeats". Output: result.stats {"nodes":31,"simplex_iterations":3577}.
recorded.prompt:q-pin:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-pin:a: "The highspy package installed beside it is HiGHS 1.14.0, a different version used only by code that imports highspy".
recorded.prompt:q-pin:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-pin:c: MathOpt runs the copy in the wheel: "ortools 9.15.6755 carries: libhighs.so.1 ..." and "the OR-Tools version pins both the HiGHS and the SCIP that MathOpt runs".
recorded.prompt:q-pin:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-pin:d: "highspy 1.14.0 (HiGHS packaged on its own, apart from the copy in the OR-Tools wheel)". These are two different HiGHS libraries, 1.12.0 and 1.14.0.
